name: Carpin Manufacturing, Inc.
old_description: Carpin was founded in 1984 as a glide and hardware manufacturing company that immediately became a leader in hardware manufacturing in the office and school furniture industries. Founder Ralph Carpinella, an engineer by education, brought his life-long manufacturing knowledge and furniture industry experience to create a customer-focused company that is based on engineering and innovation.x
about:
Carpin Manufacturing, Inc. was founded in 1984 in Waterbury, Connecticut, by Ralph Carpinella, an engineer who applied his manufacturing expertise to create a glide and hardware company serving the office and school furniture markets. His father, Henry Carpinella, played a key role in the startup and remained involved until his death in 2011, establishing a family-oriented culture that persists today.

The company operates a modern facility near Interstate 84 where it runs progressive and eyelet metal stamping, plastic injection molding, and precision assembly lines. In-house engineering, rapid prototyping, and 3D printing support custom development alongside a catalog of nearly 3,000 stock SKUs, many available for same-day shipment. A stable workforce with an average tenure of 20 years underpins consistent quality and process knowledge.

Carpin supplies floor‑protection products — glides, casters, tubular components, and specialty parts — to schools and universities, commercial and residential office furniture makers, warehouse and factory equipment builders, point‑of‑sale display manufacturers, and medical‑device firms. Notable collaborations include redesigning a side‑chair glide to eliminate field failures for a major office furniture brand and co‑developing a custom caster that matched a task chair’s aesthetic requirements.

The firm emphasizes engineering‑driven problem solving over off‑the‑shelf sales, a philosophy rooted in its founding. Patented glide designs such as the Solo, Smart, Floor Saver, and Simple lines illustrate its focus on proprietary solutions, and the company has been recognized with the James C. Smith Spirit of Excellence Award for its contributions to the industry.
